newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks fall on U.K. rate rise, Telefonica.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks fall on U.K. rate rise, Telefonica.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended down, depressed by a rise in British interest rates and a sharp correction in Telefonica. * General index fell 3.14 points, 0.83 percent, to 375.89. * Ibex-35 index lost 43.41 points, 1.0 percent, to 4,308.77. * Telefonica fell 70 pesetas, 2.64 percent, to 2,580 in heavy trading as dealers took profits after the company rose 8.83 percent in the last 12 sessions. * Repsol fell 75 pesetas to 4,155 with volume of 2.3 million shares, boosted by block trades including one by Renta 4 for 603,264 shares. Repsol has lost 7.46 percent in eight sessions.
Telefonica was dulled by Tuesday's Goldman Sach's downgrade on the stock, due to its high price.
Banks were also lower, particulary Popular and Argentaria. The latter announced a 13.1 percent fall in net profit to September after the market closed.
Turnover was high at around 63.7 billion pesetas.
